script_loading.sequence: Deduplicates via LOADED_SCRIPT_FILES; opens a PlatformFile stream, reads bytes, computes XXH64 for diagnostics, invokes luaL_loadbufferx with file basename as chunk name, calls lua_pcallk and restores prior Lua stack top. update.semantics: Absolute clocks, not delta. Native Update pushes two numbers; original Main.lua611 computes elapsed = time - _worldTime, then resumes queued coroutines using world or screen clock.

dispatch.semantics: Original Main.lua469 creates a coroutine wrapping func(triggerArgs), then resumes it through the original thread scheduler.

rng.bounded_integer: Inclusive signedlow/high, bound=uint32(high)-uint32(low)+1. If bound=0 returns low without drawing; otherwise reject PCG values below(-bound mod2^32)%bound, then output low+(value%bound) with int32 wrap.

native_behavior: DirectMovement computes angle atan2(-inputY,inputX). Low stick compares input length² against LowSpeedThreshold; picks LowSpeedFraction or1.

MoveInput normally directly sets vx=cos(angle)*maxSpeed*fraction, vy=-sin(angle)*maxSpeed*fraction. Acceleration applied as force*dt while PhysicsComponent.mFootingLostTime>0. Additional over-speed force branch exists.
Max speed=(UnitDataDef.mSpeed +unit.mSpeedAddition)*unit.mSpeedModifier, multiplied by global player speed modifier for controlled unit.
UpdateMovement uses physics mMoveShift times time-adjusted dt then ApplyFullShift collision. Move started/stopped emit corresponding ScriptManager triggers.
movement_reconstruction.limits: No claim full physics/collision reconstructed. Original Win64 member offsets are evidence, not Android ABI prescriptions.

trigger_execution_detail.registration: Read table1, optional source string at table[1]. Iterate keys, retain callable function by Lua registry reference. Invalid/no callable returns-1. Valid registration appends to per-trigger ordered vector and returns LuaFunction registry reference.
trigger_execution_detail.source_tokenizer: Split ASCII space0x20, omit empty tokens. Stop at token semicolon. Comparisons>,<,==,!=,>=,<= set comparison and next numeric token triggerValue. Full numeric token ->int ID via strtof; partly numeric token ->triggerValue; other strings ->source names. Trigger24 OnSoundComplete adds leading slash to names if absent.
trigger_execution_detail.run: Cached dispatch(func,table), creating global_triggerArgs fresh if no provided optional Lua table. Source Thing adds triggeredById and TriggeredByTable. Nonempty name adds name.
trigger_execution_detail.pre_thing_context: Registration-order run with no Thing, empty name, no optional LuaTable ->fresh empty global_triggerArgs.
